pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "der Bruder" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mother
   B. brother
   C. sister
   D. aunt

2. What does "das Sofa" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. garden
   C. plate
   D. fridge

3. What does "der Garten" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. house
   C. toilet
   D. garden

4. Which day comes right after Samstag? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Sonntag
   C. Montag
   D. Mittwoch

5. How is the "g" pronounced at the end of "Tag"? (1 mark)
   A. like k
   B. like j
   C. like g in go
   D. It is silent

6. What number is "drei"? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 12
   C. 8
   D. 3

7. What number is "fünf"? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12
   C. 0
   D. 15

8. What does "die Bohne" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. supper
   C. bean
   D. onion

9. In "Fischers Fritz fischt frische Fische", which sound repeats? (1 mark)
   A. k
   B. m
   C. f
   D. z

10. What does "die Karotte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. juice
   C. meat
   D. fish

11. Which word is a temperature word? (1 mark)
   A. Regen
   B. Wolke
   C. kalt
   D. Wind

12. Which room do you link with "Ich koche"? (1 mark)
   A. der Garten
   B. die Küche
   C. das Schlafzimmer
   D. das Badezimmer

13. How is the letter G named in German? (1 mark)
   A. gay
   B. koo
   C. emm
   D. ay

14. How is the letter P named in German? (1 mark)
   A. pay
   B. iks
   C. ess
   D. oo

15. What does "nett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. small
   B. kind
   C. old
   D. tall or big

16. Which little word goes with the noun "Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. das
   D. den

17. What does "der Topf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. pot
   B. plate
   C. clock
   D. bathroom

18. What does "die Wand" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. lamp
   B. wall
   C. sofa
   D. fridge

19. Which little word goes with the noun "Donnerstag"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

20. Which German word means "today"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. gestern
   B. jetzt
   C. heute
   D. morgen

21. Which little word goes with the noun "Mango"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

22. What does "die Schulter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toe
   B. face
   C. shoulder
   D. tooth

23. What does "der Bauch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. neck
   B. foot
   C. tooth
   D. tummy

24. What is the plural of "der Zeh"? (1 mark)
   A. die Zehe
   B. die Zehner
   C. die Zehen
   D. die Zehs

25. What does "hören" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to read
   C. to play
   D. to hear

26. What does "helfen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to sleep
   B. to help
   C. to drink
   D. to learn or study

27. Which German word or phrase means "very good"? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Abend
   B. Bis bald
   C. Sehr gut
   D. Entschuldigung

28. Which words are always written with a capital letter in German? (1 mark)
   A. Small words like und
   B. Verbs
   C. Adjectives
   D. Nouns

29. Why is "ich" written with a small letter in the middle of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. It is not a noun or a name
   B. It is a verb
   C. It is always small
   D. It is a place

30. Which German word or phrase means "friend"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschwister
   B. der Freund
   C. der Opa
   D. die Schwester

31. Which little word goes with the noun "Tante"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

32. What does "jung" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. funny
   B. small
   C. young
   D. old

33. Which German word or phrase means "radio"? (1 mark)
   A. der Schrank
   B. der Teller
   C. das Radio
   D. der Stuhl

34. What does "lernen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to drink
   B. to speak
   C. to help
   D. to learn or study

35. How many words are in the third line of an Elfchen? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 4
   D. 3

36. Which German word or phrase means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kakao
   B. das Fleisch
   C. der Kohl
   D. die Orange

37. Which food group does "die Bohne" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Gemüse

38. What does "Gestern war es windig" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it is windy
   B. Tomorrow it will be windy
   C. Yesterday it was windy
   D. It is always windy

39. What does "windig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. windy
   B. cool
   C. wet
   D. hot

40. Which German word means "sunny"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. kalt
   B. trocken
   C. heiß
   D. sonnig

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Read and translate: "Wo ist der Ball? Er ist im Garten." (2 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: hand, bread, maize. (3 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: candle, sky, cooker, knife. (4 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back, sugar, child. (5 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sofa, bathroom, potato, milk, finger. (5 marks)

46. Write three sentences that say which item is in which room. (3 marks)

47. Write the plural of Fuß, Zahn and Auge. (3 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandmother, clock. (2 marks)

49. Write the forms of "sein" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: face, father. (2 marks)

51. Write the German words with der, die or das for: thunderstorm, candle. (2 marks)

52. Fill the gaps: "Das Buch ist ___ dem Tisch. Die Katze ist ___ dem Stuhl." Use auf and unter. (2 marks)

53. Write the German names of these months: April, May, June. (3 marks)

54. Make a playful food blend from Mango and Milch, and say what it is. (2 marks)

55. Write the forms of "haben" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: spoon, supper. (2 marks)

57. Unscramble the letters TAGFIRE to make a day of the week. (2 marks)

58. Write a menu for one day in German with three meals. (3 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: table, fridge, kitchen. (3 marks)

60. Explain when we use dem and when we use der after a position word like auf or neben. (3 marks)

61. Write the German names of these months: July, August, September. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — brother
   der Bruder means brother.

2. A — sofa
   das Sofa means sofa.

3. D — garden
   der Garten means garden.

4. B — Sonntag
   After Samstag comes Sonntag.

5. A — like k
   Tag is said TAHK.

6. D — 3
   drei is the number 3.

7. A — 5
   fünf is the number 5.

8. C — bean
   die Bohne means bean.

9. C — f
   Every word begins with f or sch or f.

10. A — carrot
   die Karotte means carrot.

11. C — kalt
   kalt means cold.

12. B — die Küche
   We cook in the kitchen.

13. A — gay
   In German the letter G is called gay.

14. A — pay
   In German the letter P is called pay.

15. B — kind
   nett means kind.

16. B — die
   It is die Wand, so the little word is die.

17. A — pot
   der Topf means pot.

18. B — wall
   die Wand means wall.

19. D — der
   It is der Donnerstag, so the little word is der.

20. C — heute
   today in German is heute.

21. C — die
   It is die Mango, so the little word is die.

22. C — shoulder
   die Schulter means shoulder.

23. D — tummy
   der Bauch means tummy.

24. C — die Zehen
   The plural of der Zeh is die Zehen.

25. D — to hear
   hören means to hear.

26. B — to help
   helfen means to help.

27. C — Sehr gut
   very good in German is Sehr gut.

28. D — Nouns
   All German nouns begin with capital letters.

29. A — It is not a noun or a name
   Ich is only capital at the start of a sentence, unlike English I.

30. B — der Freund
   friend in German is der Freund.

31. C — die
   It is die Tante, so the little word is die.

32. C — young
   jung means young.

33. C — das Radio
   radio in German is das Radio.

34. D — to learn or study
   lernen means to learn or study.

35. D — 3
   The lines have 1, 2, 3, 4 and 1 words.

36. B — das Fleisch
   meat in German is das Fleisch.

37. D — das Gemüse
   die Bohne belongs to das Gemüse.

38. C — Yesterday it was windy
   gestern = yesterday and war = was.

39. A — windy
   windig means windy.

40. D — sonnig
   sunny in German is sonnig.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the ball? It is in the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Hand, das Brot, der Mais.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Kerze, der Himmel, der Herd, das Messer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken, der Zucker, das Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: das Sofa, das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch, der Finger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Füße, die Zähne, die Augen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Oma, die Uhr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich bin, du bist, er ist.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gesicht, der Vater.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gewitter, die Kerze.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: auf; unter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: April, Mai, Juni.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mangmil, a mango and milk drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible blend, 1 mark for the explanation.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich habe, du hast, er hat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Löffel, das Abendessen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Freitag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the capital letter.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Frühstück: Tee und Brot. Mittagessen: Reis und Bohnen. Abendessen: Ugali und Fisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meal correctly written.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: dem with der and das nouns (dem Tisch, dem Bett) and der with die nouns (der Tür).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dem with der nouns, 1 mark for dem with das nouns, 1 mark for der with die nouns.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: Juli, August, September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.
